overall: The AG found no violation: the Board's amended December 8, 2020 minutes are accurate and sufficiently detailed, while the untimely notice claims and previously reviewed minute claims were not reviewed again.

allegations.summary: Complaint alleged the December 8, 2020 meeting notice was insufficiently detailed or omitted topics discussed; the AG found it untimely.
allegations.key_passage: The notice allegations in this complaint are therefore untimely as they could have been discovered at the time the open session meeting took place on December 8, 2020.

allegations.summary: Complaint alleged other inaccuracies in the December 8, 2020 minutes already reviewed in OML 2021-141; the AG declined to re-review them beyond the amended portion.
Complaint alleged the amended December 8, 2020 minutes remained insufficiently detailed about the zoning by-law discussion after the prior order.
allegations.key_passage: Following our review, we find that the Board’s meeting minutes, as amended, are accurate and sufficiently detailed, and therefore find no violation of the Open Meeting Law.
